batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b A Nehra

batting.name: M Vohra
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b IC Pandey

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b R Ashwin

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b MM Sharma

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c GJ Bailey b MG Johnson

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c MG Johnson b P Awana

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b P Awana

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: st WP Saha b AR Patel

balls.text: this time Saha connects, but he can only send the ball as far as the man at deep square leg, the Mohit slower one does the job once more, CSK pull things back slightly in the last few overs, but Sehwag had already done the damage, Kings XI end on 226
Saha moves across the stumps, looks to scoop that over fine leg, this was full and just outside off, Saha doesn't connect
short of length ball outside off, slashed towards cover for a single
Miller is run-out as he looked to steal a bye after Wridhhiman Saha doesn't connect with an outside-off ball, Miller dives but not in time to beat Dhoni's throw
first-ball six for Saha, short of length ball ball is slugged over deep square leg, the man on the rope can only watch it sail over
a length ball is hammered towards wide long-off, that ball travelled real quick to the man at deep extra cover
another wicket for Nehra, Bailey is bowled as he looks to slog that one towards midwicket, that crashes into the base of middle stump, Nehra's final over costs him only 7 and gets two wickets
low full toss on the pads, thwacked towards midwicket for a single
short of length ball, punched towards long-on
nearly a yorker, even Miller can't get under that one, drilled towards long-on for a single
another full toss, slugged towards midwicket for four more

the Sehwag show is over, end of an awesome innings, Faf takes a superb catch at extra cover to send back Sehwag, he had to make a lot of ground to get there, couple of other fielders around as well, but there is no confusion, Faf takes it, a full toss ends that innings, 122 for Sehwag, CSK fielders congratulate him, Sehwag salutes the crowd as he walks off,
superb fielding by Faf at point after Sehwag plays an inside-out shot, kept to a tight single
full and wide outside off, Dhoni stops that with his pads
six more for Sehwag, again a powerful flat-batted over long-on for six, that was outside off, Sehwag doesn't care
looks for another big hit, outside edge past Dhoni for four more, CSK not having any luck here
humongous hit from Sehwag, what a shot to bring up the 200, 16 balls to go still! a length ball and Sehwag slams that over long-on way into the crowd
just outside off, crashed towards sweeper cover for a single
another full toss, CSK have decided against pitching the ball it seems, whacked towards long-off for a single
another low full toss outside off, Miller looks to slice that one, thick outside edge races past Dhoni for four more
another full toss, Miller syas thank you very much and thumps that over long-on for a massive six
full ball from round the wicket, Sehwag gets the front leg out of the way and tucks that towards midwicket

low full toss just outside off, squeezed out towards point, there's a direct hit , CSK are sure they have their man, it's tight, Miller is saved by the frame, one shows him just behind the crease with the ball just about to hit the stumps, the next shows him across the crease with the bail off, Miller tells Sehwag he though he was out
what a hit that is! power form Miller as he tees off, it was just short of a yorker, Miller doesn't care, he sends that to the long-off boundary
another full toss from Pandey, this was low and wide outside off, Sehwag has to reach out for that, he manages to, and he manges to get enough power to send that away to the point boundary
short of length ball, slower and just outside off, slapped towards point where McCullum makes a diving stop

low full toss this time, there is the century, second IPL century for Sehwag, second century of this season, Sehwag just pushes this one towards mid-off to get to the landmark, Vijay is the only other Indian batsman to have two IPL tons, Sehwag pumps his fists in celebration
fourth full toss in a row, this one is too high, a no-ball
third full toss in a row, Sehwag again can't put it away, the expectant crowd is silenced briefly, that ball only went as far as midwicket
lower full toss this time, driven to long-off for one more
a full toss, fairly high one, Sehwag can't put that away though, he can only punch it towards mid-off for a single
sliced towards sweeper cover for a single, Sehwag moves on to 98, Ashwin 4-0-44-1, not what you want from your main bowler
the crowd is baying for sehwag's century, but they will have to wait, this ball is pushed back towards the bowler
worked away for a single to deep square leg, Sehwag on strike
defended by Miller
another poor ball, sliding down the leg side, this time Miller glances it to the left of short fine leg for four more
down the leg side from over the wicket, a delicate sweep past short fine leg for four, that line is inexcusable with fine leg in the circle
fierce hit from Sehwag, he was given width, Sehwag crashes that through the covers, Raina was the man in the deep, but even he isn't quick enough to cut that off
slapped towards sweeper cover for one more
heading towards off stump from round the wicket, sliced towards deep extra cover
spinning in towards the off, worked towards midwicket for one more
wide and full from round the wicket, thumped towards sweeper cover for one more
length ball from the wicket, Miller works this towards midwicket for a isngle

but Ashwin gets the wicket he had talked up, this looked like a topspinner going straight on, it was well outside off, Maxwell looks to clobber that over cow corner, hasn't hit it far enough though and holes out, Ashwin is pumped, he runs towards Maxwell and blows a flying kiss, Dhoni is not too pleased with Ashwin's reaction
over the wicket, looked like a legbreak there, a length ball and Maxwell hammers that over long-on for six, first strike to Maxwell
wild delivery way down the leg side, at least three feet down the leg side
flat-batted away towards deep midwicket for a single
from OVER the wicket, Maxwell clips it behind square leg for a single
full ball into the pads, pushed towards long-on for a single
length ball on middle and leg, Sehwag skips down the track and makes a touch of room and then an absolutely clean hit over the bowler's head,  sensational striking from Sehwag
Ashwin starts the over with a wide down the leg side
from round the wicket, a slower one, a bit of an inside-edge towards deep backward square leg, Maxwell puts the skates on after realising a second can be taken, back in time for two
a chip towards midwicket, didn't look to power that one, it was on the pads, he just needed it to get it over the midwicket man in the circle, he does and gets a boundary
length ball pitching outside leg stump, Maxwell looks to flick it but misses and is hit on the pads
Nehra from over the wicket, a bouncer down the leg side, umpire takes a while to decide that that is a wide
low full ball on legstump, Sehwag backs away and drives towards long-off for a single
six more! short of length again from Nehra, powerfully flat-batted by Sehwag, over long-on and way into the crowd, 'that was colossal,' rightly says the giantscreen

outstanding hit from Sehwag, he has taken Nehra apart, this was back of a length ball from round the wicket, angling in towards Sehwag, who makes room and swings that over the bowler, the ball crashes into the advertising hoardings
whips this past mid-on for a single,only two off the over
yorker outside off, Sehwag can't get bat on it

the first wicket, at long last for CSK, Raina takes the catch after Vohra  top edges a short ball towards midwicket, the ball goes very high and is swirling around. CSK have been superb in the outfield all season, Raina gives another example of that
yorker on leg stump, superb delivery from Pandey , Sehwag manages to jam his bat down on that one, a single though the ball was dropped at the batsman's feet
full ball, this time Sehwag connects properly but he can't find the gap at extra cover
a full toss just outside off, low on the bat and not timed, lucky for Sehwag that the ball didn't carry to mid-off
slammed towards cow corner for a single
looking to guide the ball to third man, but is beaten, that was perilously close to the top of off stump, the umpire thinks there was an edge as well
nearly had him! Sehwag looks to slug that over midwicket, he loses his shape and he doesn't connect with the ball, which slips past the leg stump for a bye
Sehwag is enjoying himself here, Jadeja drops it a touch short, Sehwag waits on the back foot and clobbers that to the wide long-on boundary
outside off, Sehwag looks to lash it through the off side, thick top edge sends it to the third man boundary
down the leg side, a short-arm sweep sends the ball past short fine leg, a diving Mohit stops it in the deep
pushed to the right of the bowler. Ashwin moves across and dives to cut that off
carrom ball is defended to the off side
full ball on off stump, dug out towards backward point for a single
guided down towards backward point for a single
leg-stump line once more, Sehwag gets his front leg out of the way guides that towards cover
way down the leg side
goes deep into the crease and clips the ball towards square leg, Sehwag gallops the first, so there's time for the second
down the leg side, Vohra wants to sweep that but misses
solidly defended by Vohra as Jadeja fires the ball towards middle stump
eased towards long-off for a single
'YESSSS!' shouts Shastri as Sehwag hammers a pitched-up ball over the bowler's head for six more, terrific hitting here, what an entertainer
length ball sliding down the leg side, Sehwag looks to work it toward square leg, off the pads
full ball is worked towards wide mid-on
guided towards backward point for a single, haven't seen Sehwag sprint like this in a while
a trailing edge towards backward point for a single, brings up Sehwag's 50, the Wankhede crowd loves it, taken him only 21 balls
pushed towards point for a single
going down the leg side
a dot ball! CSK fans are cheering, defended by vohra
reverse-sweep now from Sehwag, only a single towards backward point
first ball is hammered onto the sightscreen by Sehwag, a length ball is flat-batted over the bowler's head, gets a big step in before launching that one
length ball, looks to work it away to the leg side, hit high on the pads
did I mention everything is going Kings XI's way? Vohra defends the ball towards cover and sets off for a tight single, throw comes in and there is an overthrow as well
the famous Mohit back-of-the-hand slower ball, on a length and that is a mistimed lofted hit towards mid-on, bounces before reaching the fielder
whipped off the pads to backward square leg

everything going Punjab's way now, Sehwag backs away and though he didn't have too much room to work with, he upper cuts it, not quite off the middle, a thick edge of sorts, still flies over the third-man rope for six
length ball on middle stump, Sehwag whips that away towards deep midwicket
length ball outside off, driven towards sweeper cover for a single
Sehwag skips down the track, making some room as well, Nehra follows him and Sehwag can swing that one away over midwicket as he intended
punched into the ground by Sehwag, bounces over Nehra but doesn't beat mid-on, no time for a single
short and down the leg side
four more, Sehwag arches back and steers this back of length ball past a diving short third man, delicately done, 55 for 0 now in the fifth over
Sehwag! pitched up and well outside off, Sehwag pounce on it, hammers that between cover and extra cover, lofted hit for four
Sehwag thumps that on-the-up, almost flat-batted by Sehwag as he dismisses that between the bowler and mid-off
the over ends just as it began, with a six over long-on, Vohra again latches on to the short ball, cleanly struck and the run-rate has now topped 10
Sehwag moves across the stumps, looking to guide the ball behind square leg, struck high on the pads and that was going over the stumps
four more, this time off a leading edge as he looked to power a full ball over the leg side, the ball flies towards the point boundary

vintage Sehwag this, not too many people can guide a ball which is just outside off to the third man boundary like Sehwag can, waits for it and plays late, the wankhede roars it approval , chants of "Viru, viru"
short again, another pull, not middled, over midwicket though, and Vohra sprints back for the third

Vohra had got only one off six Pandey deliveries last over, this time he has six off one, this was dropped short by Pandey, Vohra is good on the pull, he doesn't exactly middle it but that still flies over the wide long-on rope for six
they may have a man at sweeper cover, but there isn't one at deep point, which is where Sehwag dispatches this one
off the bottom edge as Vohra looks to thrash the ball through the off side, the ball dribbles towards mid-off
Sehwag lashes that on the up, CSK has a sweeper cover in place though it is the Powerplay overs, just the single for Sehwag
short ball outside off, sails over Sehwag's head, called a wide
length ball angling in, a pretty shot from Vohra, flicking it away towards midwicket, but Ashwin stops it there with a dive, just two off the previous nine balls for Vohra
short of length ball outside off, 133kph, moving away and beats the bat as Vohra looks to guide the ball towards third man
badly mistimed by Vohra, hit very high on the blade as he looked to launch the ball over the infield, lobs towards mid-on but lands well short
just the single off the over as Vohra guides the final ball towards third man
bangs in short this time, gets higher than Vohra expected, he was shaping for the pull but it was too high for him to play the shot
beaten outside off, Pandey getting the ball to move away just a touch, Vohra flirts with it and is beaten
looks to drive that on the up, 128kph from Pandey, Vohra swishes at the back of length ball and misses, not too far outside off from Pandey
short of length ball is defended towards backward point
Ishwar Pandey starts with a ball that nips away after pitching outside off, left alone
Sehwag doesn't need much width to thrash the ball through the off side, short of length ball outside off, slashed through covers for four, second boundary of the over
on the pads, whipped to square leg where purple-cap holder Mohit Sharma fields, Nehra lucky to get away with that loose ball
angling across outside off, guided towards deep backward point
on the pads, clipped to square leg by Vohra
there is a first-ball four for Vohra though, poor ball on the pads, glanced down to fine leg for four, easily done
no boundary first ball from Sehwag, drops the ball at his feet and sets off

Dhoni finishes it with a six, but there is to be no victory for Super Kings, it is Kings XI who are celebrating, they are into their first final of the IPL, Sehwag comes down from the dressing room to celebrate with his team, the most excited of the lot is Priety Zinta, Super Kings are deflated
low full toss is whipped towards the midwicket boundary, all moot now, still the fielder in the deep dives in an attempt to cut it off
full and outside off, slapped towards mid-off
short and well outside off, edges that past the keeper to the third-man boundary
wide outside off, Dhoni reaches out for that, slapped towards cover
length ball is inside-edge to the leg side, Mohit gets his first T20 run
swings and misses, the ball misses the stumps, the keeper misses the ball, and it's byes
charges out again, slammed towards long-off, straight at the fielder
Dhoni skips out and thumps that over long-off for six more
hammers this wider, long-on flies to his right to try cut that off, but he can't
lashes this towards long-on, but declines the single
flat and quicker, short ball angling down leg, Dhoni looking for a big hit but is struck on the body
Mohit Sharma still waiting his first run in Twenty20s, a yorker is defended back to the bowler
length ball on the pads, tucked for a single
short of length ball outside off, slapped towards backward point
a bouncer, that is surely too high, yup, a wide
full and on middle stump, thumped towards deep square leg for a couple, not happening for Dhoni today
Dhoni winds up for the big hit but he misses as he looks to clear square leg, a length ball on the pads

that should be game, set and match, Johnson has bowled a fast yorker that lasers into the base of middle stump, oh hang on! Drama, a huge no-ball here, Johnson has overstepped by a long way, Priety Zinta had celebrated so much that she was almost in tears. now I don't know how she feels
short of length and angling away, off the bottom of the bat towards midwicket
way outside off, that's a wide
length ball on middle and off, driven back to the bowler, just three runs this over when they needed 16 an over, is that the game, or  does Dhoni still have something in the bag?

Ashwin is stumped, he was struggling to get a move on here, charged out to try a big shot, he misses and is so far out of the crease that even though Wriddhiman Saha juggled the ball once before taking the bails off, Ashwin had no chance
Dhoni wants two after working the ball towards deep midwicket, no time for him to get back on strike though
a leading edge as Ashwin looks to work the ball to the leg side, the ball loops over the bowler
punched towards long-off for a single
on the pads, Dhoni looks to whip that away but is struck on the pads
full ball on off stump, eased towards long-on for a single
on the pads, tucked away towards deep square leg
short of length and angling away, slower one as well, 124kph, slapped towards cover
bouncer on leg stump, Dhoni can't get bat on it, checks with the umpire whether that is a wide, it isn't
whoah! how did that go for six? Dhoni power that's how, short ball from Johnson is forehanded over mid-off, thought it will land well short of the rope but that keeps on going, incredible hit
length ball outside off, Dhoni slogs and misses, not often Dhoni misses once he decides to go for a big hit
back to flighting the ball, bravely giving it lots of air here, full ball is driven towards long-off for asingle
quicker and fired into the pads, helped towards fine leg for a single
spinning a long way outside off, slapped past a diving point for two
loopy delivery outside off, inviting Dhoni to go for the big hits, Dhoni slaps this to point for a single
too wide outside off
Dhoni steps out of the crease, a flighted ball outside off, Dhoni misses, and with quicksilver reflexes he makes sure he gets his bat behind the crease
length ball spinning away well outside off, lashed towards sweeper cover for a single
guides this down to third man for one more
slapped towards point for one more
length ball is played uppishly towards mid-on, the man is in the deep though, and a single results
looking to hammer it to the leg side, inside-edge it instead
short of length ball, defended by Dhoni towards midwicket, Dhoni had taken a couple of paces down the track before playing the shot, so he can pinch a single
short ball moving away outside off, Ashwin guides that towards deep backward point for a single
length ball is eased towards mid-on for a single
and another one, Awana returns from his 33-run over by taking two wickets in his next, short of length ball, Hussey slugs it straight to midwicket, soft dismissal, all down to Dhoni now
length ball on middle and leg, clipped to square leg for one more
just a touch wider, again steered to backward point
short of length ball on middle stump, guided towards backward point

and another one, Chennai Super Kings losing their way here, Jadeja wanted to hammer this ball towards long-off, top edges it and it is a low chance for Mitchell Johnson at third man, Johnson does well to scoop that one, Priety Zinta is over the moon

is that another run-out? Yes, it is, McCullum pushed that towards sweeper cover, was an easy single, a misfield by Maxwell prompts them to go for the second, Maxwell fires in the throw to the keeper, not quite on top of the stumps, couple of yards wide, Saha is superb though, collects the ball and flings down the stumps, McCullum dives but he caught short
pitched up, muscled towards long-on for a single
shortish and angling in towards the pads, McCullum backs away and guides this to backward point for a single
short of length ball on off stump, pushed towards long-on for a single
on the pads, nudged away for a single
overpitched outside off, Jadeja clubs that towards long-off, powerful hit but not placed well, Miller can stop that
spinning away outside off, McCullum looking to sweep though that was well outside off, and the ball is turning away, the sweep perhaps not the best option, McCullum doesn't connect
pushed towards long-on for a single
skips down and hammers this down the ground, the fielder at long-on tries valiantly but he can't stop this one despite the dive
sees Jadeja charging down, and fires it way outside off, Jadeja gets bat on it after reaching out, can only push it to cover, he had to play it as he would have been stumped otherwise
full toss outside off, should be put away, Jadeja puts it away, skips down the track and carts that over the bowler for six
gives this plenty of air, McCullum sweeps this towards deep square leg for a single
looks to sweep this one, off the pads and towards point for a leg-bye, no lbw appeal as that was going down the leg side
tosses this one up, McCullum blocks it
flat-batted towards long-on for a single
quick and down the leg side, 106.7kph from Patel
clipped behind square for a single
tossed up, tucked away to the leg side for a single
Jadeja thumps it towards cover

slugged over mid-on for two more, McCullum has to rush back as the throw comes in to the keeper's end, and what a throw that was, right over the bails, Jadeja has to gesture toi McCullum asking him to rush back
skips down and thumps that back towards the bowler, harsh judges might call that a drop, but there was no hit with too much power, bowler sticks out his right hand to stop that
slides on, McCullum thinks that will turn away, doesn't have the room for the cut, gets the ball away though, a diving stop by Bailey
full and wide, drilled towards long-off for a single
poor ball that, spinning down the leg side, helped along to the fine-leg boundary
a touch short and spinning away, slapped towards deep point for a single
full and just outside off, pushed back towards the bowler
squeezed behind square leg, race back for the second
looked to power this through the off side, top edges this towards deep backward point
pushed towards sweeper cover for a single
flighted delivery and well outside off, left alone
just three off the over, 30 less than the previous one
superb from Maxwell at extra cover, a diving stop to prevent a sure boundary
another single down the ground
cuts that towards point for one more
the new man iis Jadeja, who drives that towards long-on for a single

a run-out first ball, Raina's masterclass is over, McCullum defends the ball towards cover and sets off for a single, there is hesitation between the batsmen before they decide to go for the single, George Bailey has a pinpoint throw from cover, catches Raina short to end what has been the best innings of the IPL! Bailey is jubilant as are the rest of Kings XI, Bailey is mobbed, Raina is distraught

100 in six overs! I am out of words! Raina finishes this over off with another boundary, this time towards deep square leg, this over has had 6 6 4 4 4nb 4 4, 33 off the over, at this rate Sehwag's son might be teased some more at his school
make that 29 off five now, Raina launches this length ball over mid-on for four more, incredible stuff this, Dhoni calm as ever in the dressing room
another boundary, I think I should just keep that in my copy-paste, high full toss outside off, Raina just helps it towards third man for four, and that is a no-ball as well
four again, 6 6 4 4 so far in this over, pitched up and outside off, carted towards deep square leg for four more

OMG! incredible from Raina, and I am soon going to run out of synonyms, this was a full ball angling away outside off, Raina flicks that towards midwicket, I thought it would be a single, instead he has found the gap and that has gone away for four

shot! Raina's innings has been peppered with some jaw-dropping hit, this is another of them, a length ball is cleanly struck over long-on, holds the pose after playing the shot, effortless and full of style
six more, everything Raina touches clears the ropes, this one is not even off the middle of the bat, high on the blade but there still enough to send that clear of the midwicket boundary

there's what Sandeep does best, gets the ball to swing, too good for Smith, moves in after pitching back of a length, moves too much for Smith to get middle as he looks to drive, sneaks between bat and pad and is bowled
nips in after pitching around off, that was sliding down the leg side though
angling in from round the wicket, Raina bottom-edges it as he slugs the ball towards midwicket

sensational batting from Raina, he's pumped up, this is the second quickest fifty in the IPL, this was a length ball, Raina gets forward and doesn't look to power the ball, he manages to get that over cover for an effortless six
follows the batsman, Smith was backing away, off the thigh pad for a leg-bye
Sandeep starts the over with a wide down the leg side
six more! Raina is on fire, he doesn't care that the bowler is Mitchell Johnson, who drops it a bit short, Raina pummels that behind square leg for six, he's now 46!
short and down the leg side, that's a wide, and it brings up CSK's 50, the batsmen punch gloves
slower one outside off, Raina was moving away from the stumps, looks to chop that behind point, beaten
smashed for six, pitched up and that is clubbed over mid-on for a big six, cracking shot that, Suresh Raina is now 41 off 13
length ball is swatted towards deep midwicket for four more, Raina hitting everything
angling in towards middle and leg, tucked towards midwicket for a single
well outside off, Smith pummels that one through the covers, a diving Akshar Patel gets a hand on that to prevent a sure boundary
a yorker outside off, squeezed towards backward point
length ball, Raina skips down the track and clobbers that over extra cover for four more, moving away from leg to make room, "CSK, CSK," the crowd yells, Raina 31 off 10 now
Raina on the rampage, a short ball on the leg stump, pulls that away behind square leg for four
on the pads, squeezed towards square leg
short of length and just outside off, smith looks for his usual swat towards square leg, no contact
Parvinder Awana starts with a tidy delivery on off stump, Smith defends this one
short ball on middle and leg, slugged to midwicket, straight at the fielder
Sandeep being taken apart here, Raina moves away from leg stump to make room, crunches this past a diving point for four
Raina is wasting no time here, the most consistent batsman in the IPL hammers this one over midwicket, into the second tier
he has packed the off-side field and has sent mid-off deep but bowls this one into the pads, Sandeep escapes though as Raina doesn't connect and is struck on the pad
cracked past mid-off for four, a short of length ball and that is hit sweetly in the air past mid-off for four
a length ball to start is launched over mid-off for four, Raina had to reach across for that one, connects well
length ball, on the pads, and Smith plays that late, turns his wrists to work it to deep square leg
looks to pull from outside off, and it goes off the toe-end of his bat towards mid-on
digs it in again, targeting Raina with the short ball, but it's angled down leg, and he gets a tickle on it, trying to work it off his rib-cage on the hop
back-foot push to mid-on

gone first ball! Johnson dug that in, and Faf tried to pull from shoulder-height, outside off, and ends up spooning it way up in the air. George Bailey, at mid-on, waits an age before it drops into his hands
just back of a length, gives Smith a bit of width, and he's slashed it, a touch uppishly, towards Sandeep Sharma at third man
